blurb: Guests embark on dolphin and sunset excursions featuring dolphin and marine life sightseeing and coastal views. Cruises include a scenic tour through Choctawhatchee Bay, Crab Island sandbar, and Destin Harbor with narration. Trips then head into the Gulf of Mexico to search for wild dolphins or explore calmer bay waters if conditions are rough.
